'''T-289 stun gas''' was a compound that induced nausea, disorientation and vomiting. Non-fatal except in large doses, T-289 stun gas was used in [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms']] [[T-289 gas grenade]].<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
